author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand responds to London Mayor Sadiq Khan’s Easter message, reflecting on themes of faith, unity, and political leadership in the UK.

The discussion touches on Easter, Christian values, social unity, and broader commentary on politics and governance in London. Brand offers his perspective on the message and expands into a wider reflection on society, leadership, and institutional power.

This video highlights a moment where religion, politics, and public messaging intersect in modern Britain.

#RussellBrand #SadiqKhan #Easter #London #Politics #UKNews #Faith #Commentary
title: Remember what Easter is truly about...
